blast.bookkeeping: settleAfterDamage recomputes cleared waves, syncs the queue, resolves a cleared Siege, or appends three Endless waves before validation
blast.targeting: finite world point inside the frozen 9x15 board; omitted point uses the hero world position; lane index is not a distance
blast.mana: 40 on an accepted cast, including a miss; rejected points leave mana and the session unchanged
blast.xp: blast passes a null source, so towers and the army gain no experience

saves.morale: a pending bonus must be the living active stack, with granted true, checked true, and bonusRound equal to the current round
saves.defenseXp: session tower, army and hero combat experience must be finite and nonnegative
saves.dwelling: open offer id, count, multiplier and claimed flag must equal the single history row for that site and type

defenseRoster.survivors: ceil(hp/unitHp) capped at the deployed count
defenseRoster.hero: campaign deployment uses attack*3, range 2.2, rate 1.1 and 400 HP
defenseRoster.slowSupport: slow and support towers do not emit gun projectiles
defenseRoster.heroCombatXpPolicy: The session heroXp accumulator is not granted at settlement. Completed Hero Hall victory XP remains the hero grant. The old endBattle also omitted this accumulator.

endlessFormula.compositionIndex: Extension batches use wavePlan index 0, 1, 2. Source genWaves restarts that index on each added batch.
endlessFormula.core: Endless multiplies 400+180*walls+60*age by 1.4, matching source bStart.

earnedScope.endless: cleared 20, extended 3 to 24, core then fell, q6 claimed once after reload
earnedScope.resurrect: Closing with the duel wolf wounded a stack to 26/41 HP and the wolf died to retaliation in that same action, so the battle resolved before a cast. The earned cast that does occur is on a full 5x57 stack and the pool stays 285. The isolated fixture still restores a wounded stack from 2 to 3 under 20 mana.

notDone: Earned Resurrection recovery on a wounded living stack. The seed cast it on a full stack.
